keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 2023 (a rebel state Cliopatria lacks): at the end of 2023 the RSF held 'most of Darfur' (Nyala fell 26 October), most of Khartoum ('By late October, RSF controlled most of Khartoum but had failed to seize key military bases') and, from late December, Gezira State (Wad Madani). The page gives no territory figures or percentages.

West Kordofan around Al-Fulah, its capital (Al-Fulah is not in the gazetteer; Muglad is the nearest listed town)

correction.text: Darfur except El Fasher, Khartoum, Gezira State and the Al-Fulah area of West Kordofan

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 2024: 'In June 2024, the RSF were still in control of Khartoum and Khartoum North'; Al-Fulah, the capital of West Kordofan, fell on 20 June 2024 ('On 20 June 2024, the RSF captured Al-Fulah'); Singa and the Sennar towns fell on 29 June and were retaken, Singa on 23 November 2024, so Sennar is not in the year-end shape; El Fasher was besieged from April 2024 and was still held by the army at year end; Gezira stayed RSF land until the army retook Wad Madani on 11 January 2025.

ledger.note: 2023: the Rapid Support Forces go to war on 15 April. 'Fighting began on 15 April 2023 following a power struggle within the transitional administration'; 'their conflict erupted into a civil war starting with the battles in the streets of Khartoum' (Sudan page).
2023: the battle for Khartoum. By late October 'RSF controlled most of Khartoum but had failed to seize key military bases'.

region.text: most of Darfur, without El Fasher

ledger.note: 2023: the RSF takes Darfur. 'By late 2023, the RSF controlled most of Darfur'; 'On 26 October, RSF captured Nyala'. El Fasher stayed in army hands.
2023: the RSF takes Gezira in December. 'RSF forces began to move into Gezira State on 15 December' and took Wad Madani after several days.

24-25 January 2024: Babanusa. 'On 24 January 2024, the RSF launched an attack on Babanusa'; 'By 25 January, the RSF gained control of the city centre and entered the headquarters of the 22nd infantry division'.

region.text: El Fasher, the last Darfur state capital under army control

ledger.note: 2024: the siege of El Fasher begins in April. El Fasher 'was besieged by the RSF from April 2024'; 'Beginning on 11 April, RSF ground and aerial assaults struck El Fasher'. The city fell on 26 October 2025.

region.text: West Kordofan around Al-Fulah, its capital (Al-Fulah is not in the gazetteer; Muglad is the nearest listed town)

ledger.note: 20 June 2024: the RSF takes West Kordofan's capital. 'On 20 June 2024, the RSF captured Al-Fulah'; the army withdrew to Babanusa, its last base in Kordofan. The infobox's 'RSF occupies parts of Darfur and Kordofan' is now matched. The state's extent is the researcher's reading (a 100 km circle at Muglad).

region.text: Sennar State south of Sennar city: Singa, Dinder, Mazmoum and Wad an-Nail (the city of Sennar was avoided)

ledger.note: 29 June 2024: the RSF takes Singa. The RSF 'avoided Sennar and attacked south towards Singa', 'capturing the lightly defended town on 29 June', and then occupied Dinder, Mazmoum and Wad an-Nail 'with minimal SAF resistance'.

region.text: Sennar State south of Sennar city: Singa, Dinder, Mazmoum and Wad an-Nail (the city of Sennar was avoided)

ledger.note: 23 November 2024: 'the SAF retook Singa following an offensive'; the army's October 2024 counteroffensives in Sennar and Gezira had 'successfully recaptured' ground from the RSF.

zones.text: most of Darfur, without El Fasher

wars.outcome: Ongoing at the end of the dossier's span: the RSF holds most of Darfur and Khartoum and took Gezira in December 2023; the army retook ground in late 2024.
wars.note: Events after 2024 lie beyond the span: the army retook Wad Madani on 11 January 2025 and Khartoum in March 2025; the RSF formed the Government of Peace and Unity (Sudan Founding Charter February 2025, infobox April 2025); El Fasher fell on 26 October 2025.

certainty.note: The page gives front lines by city, not by boundary.

sources.note: Start 15 April 2023, RSF control of Darfur, Khartoum and Gezira, the El Fasher siege, the 2025 events. Re-read 2026-10-24 for the fix run.

sources.title: Sudan
sources.note: 'On 15 April 2023, their conflict erupted into a civil war starting with the battles in the streets of Khartoum'; the RSF's rival government of April 2025.

notes: A rebel state Cliopatria lacks, the counterpart of republic-of-sudan's 2023-2024 loss and contest events. The RSF did not govern a state before 2025 (the rival Government of Peace and Unity dates from February to April 2025, beyond this span), so capitals are empty. The page's infobox lists the RSF's territory as 'parts of Darfur and Kordofan'; West Kordofan is drawn from June 2024 (Al-Fulah, 20 June 2024; a 100 km circle at Muglad, since Al-Fulah is not in the gazetteer) and Babanusa is a contest from January 2024; the first run wrote that the page names no Kordofan city, which the reviewer showed to be wrong. The page flags inconsistent infobox allies. Wikipedia title 'Rapid Support Forces' is assumed; the Wikidata id is unknown. Fix run of 2026-10-24: Singa and the Sennar towns (29 June 2024) and their loss (Singa, 23 November 2024) are events; the Sudan dossier now cuts the RSF-held Darfur, Gezira and West Kordofan from its 2023 and 2024 keyframes, so the overlap of the two sides is gone except in Khartoum, which both hold as contested land. Gazetteer: Al-Fulah (place, West Kordofan).
